lci.text: Malcolm, a winged siren pirate, examines a fungus-ridden corpse near Sunray Bay and learns from a note that Downtown is under attack, then finds Downtown empty and abandoned with the word DOWN painted in ichor beside a lowered elevator.
He and his crew descend the cenote, where a fungus-ridden raptor corpse attacks, and Malcolm sings to enthrall the creatures and his crew.
Black fungus spreads from the crew's wounds, so Malcolm and Breeches cut the elevator cables to drop the infected pirates into the dark, leaving the two of them as the only survivors of his party.

In a vast fungal forest they meet the Mycotyrant, speaking through mayor Xavier Sal, which says it wants the sun above and will ascend to the surface, and Malcolm sings to stun the colony so they can escape.
